summary: Iteration 5 - Portal Health Summary feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass (/api/portal/health shape, staff 403, unauth 401, client only sees own computers, TT-ENG-WS03 math = 75 Good with security=20 updates=20, multi-computer averaging + expected recommendations after temporarily assigning TT-ACCOUNTING-02 to Acme, and regression on /api/portal/overview and /api/portal/fleet/data). Frontend: portal login works, PortalHealth component renders score ring (75), grade 'Good', summary text, four category rows (updates=Fair, security=Needs attention, access=Good, storage=Good) each with text labels not just color, recommendations list 'Turn the Windows firewall back on' and 'Install the latest Windows security updates' with affected computers, and the Health column pill shows 75/100 for TT-ENG-WS03. Test data restored (TT-ACCOUNTING-02 back to unassigned, verified in finally block).
critical_code_review_comments: No GET /api/scans/{sid} endpoint exists (only DELETE); tests had to read scans via Mongo directly. Minor - fine for internal use.
server.py has grown to 913 lines; consider splitting portal and client routers into separate modules for maintainability.

fleet_health averaging uses `round(sum/N)` which can display 100 while individual computers are <100 due to rounding; acceptable but may surprise clients when overall shows 100 and categories show 99/100 pct.
